dct_description_sm:
Note: Statistics Canada does not recommend using the data in a time series due to methodological changes through time, please see the Business Register concepts page for more information: https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/statistical-programs/document/1105_D16_V2

The dataset is in Beyond 20/20 (.ivt) format. The Map & Data Library exported these .ivt files as .csv files for ease of use. In some cases, Borealis ingested these .csv files as .tab files instead.

The Beyond 20/20 browser is required in order to open any .ivt files. This software can be freely downloaded from the Statistics Canada website: https://www.statcan.gc.ca/eng/public/beyond20-20 (Windows only).

This dataset is a custom tabulation of the Canadian Business Counts product from the Business Register, that includes: establishment counts by dissemination area, 6-digit NAICS and employment size range. Datasets are available for December 2007-2022, 2024-2025, and June 2013-2022. This product was formerly known as Canadian Business Patterns.
